Basic embedding request for a single input string

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"Hello world\",\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.embed(request: _request)
print(result)
```
